moa: Nitrogen-binding prodrug (phenylbutyrate, converted to phenylacetate which conjugates glutamine for urinary excretion)

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 203284, Company: HORIZON THERAP US, RAVICTI GLYCEROL PHENYLBUTYRATE ... 02/01/2013 ORIG-1 Approval Type 2 - New Active Ingredient STANDARD; Orphan

launch_evidence.quote: RAVICTI net sales were $0.8 million for the first quarter of 2013, representing orders received by patients post-approval. The FDA granted approval of RAVICTI on February 1, 2013.

series_end_reason: Horizon's last quarterly release is for 2023Q2 (8-K filed 2023-08-08; Form 15-12G filed 2023-10-16 after Amgen completed the acquisition on Oct. 6, 2023). Amgen's product sales detail table prints no RAVICTI line in any quarterly release from the fourth quarter of 2023 (filed 2024-02-06) through the third quarter of 2026 (filed 2026-11-03); its Horizon-derived lines are TEPEZZA, KRYSTEXXA and UPLIZNA.

unreported_quarters.2015Q2: Ownership change Hyperion Therapeutics to Horizon; no full-quarter figure is published. Horizon acquired Hyperion on May 7, 2015; Hyperion's last periodic report is the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2015, and Horizon's 2015Q2 release prints RAVICTI 19.0 covering only May 7-June 30 (footnote 'RAVICTI and BUPHENYL were acquired on May 7, 2015'), so 2015Q2 is excluded.

search_log: [Hyperion piece] Listed every Hyperion Therapeutics (CIK 0001386858) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions: 44 8-K, 3 8-K/A, 8 10-Q, 1 10-Q/A, 3 10-K, 2 10-K/A. Fetched every 8-K exhibit (items 2.02/9.01/7.01) filed 2013-01 to 2015-08 and every 10-Q/10-K primary document filed 2013-2015.

[Hyperion piece] Hyperion's statement of operations prints RAVICTI plus BUPHENYL (acquired May 31, 2013) as one 'Product revenue, net' line. RAVICTI is printed on its own line in the 10-Q notes table for 2014Q2, 2014Q3 and 2015Q1 (thousands, used) and in each quarterly release's revenue discussion (used for 2013Q1-2014Q1 and 2014Q4, where the 10-Q has no product table).

[Hyperion piece] 2014Q2 (31,553) includes previously deferred revenue recognized in the quarter, as printed (release: '$31.6 million of RAVICTI recognized in the quarter including $11.7 million of previously deferred revenue').

[Horizon piece] Listed every Horizon Therapeutics plc / Horizon Pharma plc (CIK 0001492426) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions (recent + older pages): 217 8-K, 6 8-K/A, 37 10-Q, 12 10-K (all forms counted). Took every 8-K/8-K/A filed 2013-01 to 2023-10 whose items include 2.02, 9.01 or 7.01 and fetched every non-primary .htm exhibit via each filing's index.json.

[Horizon piece] Read the product row from the first table of each quarterly release whose first cell starts with the brand (net sales by product table, USD millions, current three-month column first). Where several 8-K exhibits of one quarter carried the brand (e.g. 2016-10-13 / 2016-12-22 acquisition exhibits with unrelated tables), only the quarterly earnings release (Form 8-K, figure below 10,000) was kept.

[Horizon piece] Horizon's last earnings release is for 2023Q2 (8-K filed 2023-08-08); it filed a Form 15-12G on 2023-10-16 after Amgen completed the acquisition on Oct. 6, 2023, and published no third-quarter 2023 results.
